    The Cartan matrix of a directed algebra #

    The Cartan matrix has entries dim e_j A e_i (cartan). For a directed algebra it is lower triangular along a linear extension of the path order with ones on the diagonal, so its determinant is one (det_cartan) and it is invertible over ℤ. The Euler form ⟨u, v⟩ = (C⁻¹ u) · v satisfies ⟨dim P(i), v⟩ = v_i (euler_cartan_col).
